author: Inside Edition
description: Rescuers scoured the Michigan woods for a boy and two young women who had been missing for three days. Suddenly, they got a faint response from somewhere in the distance, and rescuers found the missing trio. Video shows how badly cut up one of the women's legs were after the three-day ordeal. The trio was enjoying a day of tubing on a river when their tubes were punctured by logs. Inside Edition spoke to three of the rescuers.
title: Family Found Alive After Going Missing In Michigan Woods For 3 Days

author: Inside Edition
description: This bride and groom will never forget their wedding day, and it is not just because they said "I do." At the altar, the bride got a little teary-eyed and needed a handkerchief. It appeared as if the priest was offering one, and she dabbed her tears. But it turned out to be part of the priest's robe. The bride tells Inside Edition she had reason to think the priest was handing her something. The embarrassing video went viral on TikTok.
title: Bride Mistakenly Dries Teary-Eyes With Priest's Robe

author: Inside Edition
description: From the ocean to the Great Lakes, technology is helping rescuers reach swimmers in distress faster. In Ocean City, New Jersey, police and lifeguards demonstrate how rescue drones can drop flotation devices to swimmers caught in dangerous rip currents. In New Buffalo, Michigan, lifeguards deploy EMILY, a remote-controlled rescue device that speeds out to struggling swimmers and keeps them afloat until help arrives.
title: How Drones Are Saving Swimmers From Drowning

author: Inside Edition
description: Homicide investigators in New South Wales, Australia, were out in full force after two people came upon an abandoned suitcase and opened it to find what they thought were human body parts. Upon investigation, officials say Australians can rest easy. Investigators say it was a lifelike doll that the concerned citizens found, but they may have been thrown by hair, a nose ring, and bruised legs that were inside the suitcase. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Investigators In Australia Say Human Remains Turned Out To Be Lifelike Doll
